<div class="project-text">
  <h2>Pyrolysis of Biochar and growth effects on plantsg</h2>
  <p>
    This project analyzes biochar effects on soil and vegetation using <em><strong>Principal Component Analysis (PCA)</strong></em>, <em><strong>K-Means clustering</strong></em>, and <em><strong>ANOVA</strong></em>. These methods identify key biochar properties, classify nutrient patterns.
  </p>
</div>
